newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea 3-yr yields end higher on tight liquidity.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea 3-yr yields end higher on tight liquidity.

text.p: Yields on three-year benchmark corporate bonds closed slightly higher on Tuesday, reflecting worries about a liquidity squeeze by the central bank, dealers said.
They said Monday's repos issued by the central bank dried up short-term liquidity, pushing overnight call rate to a high of 14.20.
Reflecting tight liquidity in the short-term market, the overnight call rate hit a daily high of 14.20. Dealers said the level might be this month's peak.
Inflation, gauged on the consumer price index, rose 4.3 percent in April on the year, down from a 4.6 percent rise a year earlier.
But the market ignored the indicators, dealers said.
